messages:
rita-finance: FYI finalization run just finished but Support reports some customers got invoices missing the 'reserved capacity' line and a few got two different finalized invoices. spotted by reconciliation.

omar-eng: can we have an example invoice id + customer so i can trace?

rita-finance: INV-2024-6123 / cust-enterp-900. Customer received INV-2024-6123 (no reserved line) and INV-2024-6123-alt (has reserved line). Totals differ by $8,400.

deploy-bot: deploy billing-finalizer:v4.2 completed 2501234450 by ci-pipeline (includes cache-coherence fix)

billing-bot: finalize_batch:202406 status=SUCCESS 2501234460 invoices_finalized=17200 duplicates_emitted=18

omar-eng: quick triage: finalizer looks up reserved_commit_id from commit-cache service. after a recent optimization the cache is updated asynchronously and the finalizer reads a transient stale view if it races with commit attribution job. if stale -> reserved_amount defaults to 0 in the render path. duplicates probably from retry path where another worker read fresh cache.

ops-sre: @omar can you confirm if the cache had a TTL change recently? logs?

omar-eng: TTL wasn't changed, but commit-attribution job switched from batch write to stream write at 2501234400 (migration commit d4e9). That means there is a small window where cache isn't yet populated. reproducer below.

omar-eng: reproducer: 
```
# pseudo
commit_attr_job streams attribution -> updates commit-cache async
finalizer_worker A runs before cache update -> sees commit_amount=0 -> emits invoice without reserved line
finalizer_worker B runs after cache update -> sees commit_amount=8400 -> emits invoice with reserved line; emitter appends -alt to second id
```

jun-support: we have ~12 tickets so far, several customers already paid the higher invoice. urgent: pause payout and hold any outbound invoice emails for batch 202406.

cfo: pause payouts and hold emails for affected cohort. finance will prepare credit memos and refunds as needed. notify legal if any regulatory exposure for EU customers.

omar-eng: mitigation: 1) change finalizer to read DB fallback when cache miss or stale timestamp < 30s, 2) add an atomic finalize lock on canonical_order_id to prevent two finalizes for same order, 3) add an alert if finalize_duplicate_count > 0. patch ready.

ops-sre: invalidating commit-cache for affected customers now. queueing re-finalize.

billing-bot: re_finalize_job queued for batch=202406 by ops-sre at 2501234680

omar-eng: hotfix pushed at 2501234705: db fallback + finalizer idempotency. also added metric commit_cache_stale_rate.

billing-bot: re_finalize_job started 2501234720 status=IN_PROGRESS items=18

jun-support: holding outbound communications until finance confirms list of affected invoices. drafting message: "We're reviewing a discrepancy in invoice rendering for a small set of customers. We're reissuing corrected invoices and issuing credits where required."

billing-bot: re_finalize_job completed 2501234810 status=SUCCESS duplicates_voided=18 credits_issued=14 refunds_initiated=4

rita-finance: ran diffs on top impacted customers, reserved amounts now present and ledger reconciles. prepping customer outreach list and credit memos.

ops-sre: postmortem action items: 1) ensure finalizer reads DB fallback on cache miss, 2) add finalize idempotency metric and alert, 3) include render-preview smoke test in commit-attribution deploy checklist.

omar-eng: leaving logs for the postmortem: 
```
ERROR finalizer: commit-cache stale for cust-enterp-900 at 2501234422; defaulted reserved_amount=0
WARN finalizer: duplicate finalize detected for order ord-5512 -> emitted INV-2024-6123-alt at 2501234459
```

cfo: good work triaging. finance will coordinate refunds + customer comms. assign owners in the incident doc.

rita-finance: creating incident ticket with timeline and affected invoice ids now. will post update when outreach sent. thanks everyone. :wave:
